summary:
The bulk of recent pop-os sessions went into homelab GPU coordination. The broker serializing P100 access across the text-gen and image-gen backends is fully operational — SillyTavern confirmed end-to-end, lock logic tightened after a reload-storm regression by switching from an allowlist of safe paths to an enumerated set of mutating endpoints. That change brought five parallel version pings down to 33ms total.

The inference stack is otherwise stable. Each P100 consumer has its own idle-unload configuration, and the broker handles eviction before forwarding mutating requests so no service OOMs another. TTS moved to CPU entirely after VRAM accounting made it unnecessary to keep it on the GPU.

On phillipsben, the big push this week was the site assistant: six phases from zero to live, covering the /ask API route, build-time knowledge pack with redaction, chat overlay, hero call-to-action band, and adversarial prompt hardening with model cost-tiering. Flagship write-up committed. (snapshot stale, last sync 2026-05-19)

highlights.oneLiner: Site assistant shipped end-to-end across six phases — knowledge pack, chat overlay, hero band, and adversarial hardening all live.
Daily cron stable; pop-os memory snapshot pipeline live and writing this tile each morning.
